newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police remand man for attack on Britons.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police remand man for attack on Britons.

text.p: A Cyprus court on Wednesday ordered the remand of a man on suspicion of assaulting two British women and possibly attacking another foreign woman in the coastal resort of Paphos, police said on Wednesday.
Greek Cypriot Stephanos Peratikos, 22, was remanded for three days to complete inquiries surrounding the attack on British holidaymakers Linda Lahiff, 33, and Ellen Brooks, 45, police said.
"The case will be presented to court as soon as possible," a spokesman said.
Lahiff, from Glasgow, and Brooks, from Kent, told police they were attacked by an unknown assailant holding a sharp instrument on Monday night. Both women sustained scratches to their thighs.
Peratikos has confessed to the offences under investigation, police said. He is due to undergo tests by a psychiatrist.
Paphos, on the island's western coast, is a favourite for thousands of British holidaymakers. Crime is rare.
Monday's assaults occurred in the space of 20 minutes as the women were walking along busy streets in the resort with their husbands.
A similar assault involving a foreign woman occurred on Saturday and police are investigating whether it was linked to the other attacks, a police spokesman said.
